prog='''def norm(cells):
    mr=min(r for r,c in cells); mc=min(c for r,c in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cells))

def transform(grid):
    colors=[x for row in grid for x in row]
    seedcol=max(set(colors) - {0,1}) if len(set(colors))>2 else None
    if seedcol is None:
        return [r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=0
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]==seedcol]
    if not seeds: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    shape=norm(seeds); ph=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    H=len(grid);W=len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r0 in range(H-ph+1):
        for c0 in range(W-pw+1):
            if all(grid[r0+dr][c0+dc]==bg for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=seedcol
